rules: Quiet watch for on-the-horizon items. Check at most 2 reads per sweep, rotating by oldest last_checked. Stay silent until a trigger fires. A demo clip, teaser, waitlist, interview or opinion is never a trigger. When one fires: add one kept item to that sweep, set status to 'triggered' with triggered_at and evidence, and flag it in the status file for the parent to tell Cameron. Never put speculative what-ifs in sweep output.

entries.name: Block Dessa full-duplex speech-to-speech model
entries.why: Audio-only, text-free full-duplex speech model said to run faster than real time on an M4 Max MacBook Pro; a local-weights release could become a voice front end for the fleet.
entries.trigger: A concrete release: downloadable weights, a public API or SDK, a technical paper or report (arXiv or similar), or public access beyond the safety-researcher early access.
not_trigger: new demo clips or sizzle videos
waitlist or early-access sign-ups for safety researchers
reposts of the original Oct 2026 demo page

queries: Dessa (weights OR huggingface.co OR arxiv OR API OR paper OR "open source") (Block OR @blocks) -is:retweet
handles_unverified: @dessa_ai (exists, empty bio; may be the old Dessa startup account)
checks.handle_notes: @ragavan is a different person (ex-Llama at Meta), not Ragavan Thurairatnam; his X handle is not yet known.

entries.last_result: 2 reads plus block.xyz/dessa: still research preview (demo clips, safety-researcher early access, waitlist); no weights, API or paper.
